physical_observation.effect: Preflight failed closed before live WAIT watcher / pre-candidate smoke and before any Altrady release smoke.

root_cause.detail: The MINI-PC preflight still referenced the spec-runtime compatibility test from superseded PR #9, but fresh PR #40 had ported the runtime modules/tests without that compatibility module. Cloud PR validation did not name the missing module, so it could remain green while the physical preflight correctly failed closed.

repair.cloud_coverage: tests/test_v2r4_evaluator_contract.py imports the compatibility TestCase so the existing V2R4 PR validation executes it without changing the canonical workflow.
